classification_paths.evidence_quote: Senior Quality Engineer - Expanded Beam Optics
classification_paths.industry_evidence_quote: 3M is a place where you can collaborate with other curious, creative 3Mers. This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, government or military experience to a 3M career.

jobs.summary: This role requires a bachelor's degree in engineering and three years of experience in product and manufacturing quality, including advanced planning, process controls, and root cause analysis. The engineer must maintain quality baselines, govern control plans, and lead risk management activities for expanded beam optics products across global sites.
jobs.description_excerpt: Job Description: Senior Quality Engineer* Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World Choosing where to start and grow your career has a major impact on your professional and personal life, so it’s equally important you know that the company that you choose to work at, and its leaders, will support and guide you.

jobs.summary: The role requires a systems architect with 10+ years of experience to design and ship scalable backend systems for 1X's global robot operations. The candidate must possess deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud architecture, and real-time data pipelines while leading technical direction and mentoring engineers.
jobs.description_excerpt: About 1X We’re building humanoid robots that work in home - doing the chores, handling the tasks, and giving people their time back. Simple, but it’s not. To do this right, we have to solve robotics, AI, manufacturing - at the same time, at scale, in a form factor that has to be safe enough to live with your family. If you’re inspired by this, you’ll thrive here.
